plan.title: System integrity recovery: trustworthy gates, live-harm fixes, sweeps, retro-review, remediation
plan.goal: Restore trustworthy verification, stop live harm, find and fix unfound issues, then resume feature work
success_criteria: No PR merges with a fabricated review, fake gate, red test, or forged acceptance
All P2 sweeps run clean or every finding is tracked
Every retro-review NOT_CORRECT item fixed, archived, or deferred with a date

phases.name: Trustworthy verification
phases.goal: Gates that can fail and cannot be faked

phases.name: Stop live harm
phases.goal: Fix security and broken live paths

phases.name: Resume feature work
phases.goal: Return to roadmap on honest state

items.name: Review receipts required
items.goal: PR review claims bound to minted receipts from real reviewer runs (#634)
items.validation_goal: review-disposition rejects a PR without a valid receipt; tests green

items.name: Always-PASS stub gates removed
items.goal: Archive six tier0 gates that cannot fail (#637)
items.validation_goal: tier0 count equals real gates

items.name: PR body layout enforced
items.goal: Details first, then What/How/Why; CI-checked (#636)
items.validation_goal: check-pr-body-format fails a non-conforming body

items.name: Forged/self acceptances reset + acceptor check
items.goal: Reset 91 acceptances; --check rejects agent/test acceptors (#635)
items.validation_goal: aq-pm-tracker --check rejects agent/test acceptor; tests green

items.name: All test files run in CI
items.goal: Gate fails if any scripts/testing/test-*.py is red or unregistered
items.validation_goal: manifest-vs-filesystem gate fails on an undeclared test-*.py; a deliberately red test fails CI

items.name: Tests cannot mutate live state
items.goal: Gate fails if a test run changes PULSE.log or RESUME.json
items.validation_goal: tests run with state paths in a temp dir; gate fails if git status changes after the test run

items.name: Owner sign-off bound to aq-approve
items.goal: by: hyperd acceptances require an aq-approve record
items.validation_goal: an acceptance without an approval record fails --check

items.name: Gate mutation tests
items.goal: Every tier0.d gate has a test proving it can fail
items.validation_goal: mutation suite: each gate fails on its known-bad input

items.name: SHIPPED requires activation evidence
items.goal: aq-pm-tracker projects SHIPPED only with an activation signal (wired caller, enabled unit, or live check) plus a registered test; otherwise caps at BUILT
items.validation_goal: a tracker item with code but no activation signal projects BUILT, not SHIPPED; test proves it

items.name: Untrusted-author hold on Gemini-shipped items
items.goal: Provenance hold on every tracker item shipped by Gemini PRs 2026-10-19..27; projection capped below SHIPPED until receipt-backed re-verification
items.validation_goal: a held item projects below SHIPPED; clearing requires a valid receipt; test proves both

items.name: AppArmor rule insertion safety
items.goal: Validate rules, show rule text in aq-approve, no auto-commit
items.validation_goal: injection regression tests; reviewed PR

items.name: Gemini egress attribution
items.goal: Attribute gemini lane; hold raw IPs
items.validation_goal: egress CLI allows gemini; raw IPs hold; live dispatch succeeds

items.name: MCP protocol negotiation
items.goal: Hybrid bridge negotiates protocol version
items.validation_goal: Claude Code connects to hybrid-coordinator after deploy

items.name: REA launcher + classifier tests gated
items.goal: Launcher calls aq-confine correctly; both tests green and in CI; WR-REA-1 tracked
items.validation_goal: tests green in CI

items.name: Lean Codex reviews + budget measuring real use
items.goal: aq-review-request builds a front-loaded review prompt (diff inline, narrow questions, output contract) for codex or local; delegate-to-codex budget becomes a rolling 24h window with a reserved review share; usage-limit cooldown remains primary
items.validation_goal: a real Codex review completes well under the old ~65k tokens; implement-role dispatch refused while review headroom remains; budget tests cover rolling window and reserve

items.name: No sleep during agent work
items.goal: delegate-to-* hold a systemd sleep inhibitor while tasks run
items.validation_goal: a running delegated task shows in systemd-inhibit --list; no resume restart mid-task

items.name: Local model throughput restored
items.goal: Measured root cause of 1.7-2.0 tok/s fixed declaratively; tok/s probe + alert
items.validation_goal: warm gen tok/s back to >= baseline 5.3; probe alerts below threshold

items.name: Sleep-resilient, mobile local work
items.goal: Health-gated restart on resume, auto-retry of interrupted delegated tasks, opt-in keep-awake (lid) mode with battery/thermal guards
items.validation_goal: suspend/resume during a running local task: task completes without manual retry; keep-awake holds lid inhibitor only while tasks run and releases on guard trip

items.name: Sweep: every test file
items.goal: Execute all test files; dated red list
items.validation_goal: report under docs/harness-first/evidence

items.name: Sweep: gates under known-bad input
items.goal: List gates that cannot fail
items.validation_goal: report

items.name: Sweep: enabled units/timers
items.goal: Every enabled unit running and producing output
items.validation_goal: report

items.name: Sweep: dashboard card provenance

items.validation_goal: report

items.name: Sweep: tracker claims vs evidence
items.goal: Every tracker item: code on main, wired, enabled, observable, tested
items.validation_goal: report

items.name: Sweep: MCP servers and agent lanes
items.goal: Each connects / dispatches
items.validation_goal: report

items.name: Retro-review 2026-10-13..18
items.goal: 40 PRs (#499-#538) + 98 PR-less commits, same rubric; non-Claude reviewer for Claude work
items.validation_goal: batch reports in .agents/delegation/outputs

items.name: Remediate security findings
items.goal: All NOT_CORRECT security items from batches A-C fixed or archived
items.validation_goal: each slice: failing test first, receipt, PR

items.name: Remediate dashboard truth
items.goal: No hardcoded/fake card values; unbacked cards show --
items.validation_goal: P2.4 sweep clean

items.name: Dormant features: wire+activate or archive
items.goal: Rule 23 for every dormant item found
items.validation_goal: P2.5 sweep clean

items.name: Real open-weights System 1 model
items.goal: Small local model for pre/post-agent tasks within the RAM budget set by P1.7
items.validation_goal: measured latency/quality on triage+classification fixtures; live and wired
